recommendations.headline: Satisfaction is the single biggest lever on conversion - satisfied calls close at 71% versus just 15% for neutral calls (51% of all calls) and 5% for dissatisfied calls, yet overall order conversion is only 19%.
behaviour: Callback is the most common outcome (1,253 of 2,706 calls, 46%) versus order (522, 19%), showing most customers defer rather than decide on the call.

Price-benchmarking is widespread: price_shopper behaviour in 465 calls, comparing_quotes in 280, and price_high is the top objection (361 calls) alongside named competitors JSW (70), Tata (46), Asian (29).
Urgency and delivery speed matter: 357 high-urgency calls, fast_delivery is the top customer need (492) and site_delivery needed in 112 calls.
Technical clarification is a core part of the buying journey: needs_technical_help in 399 calls and technical_advice needed in 447 calls, often before an order is confirmed.

Repeat and bulk business is sizeable (repeat_buyer 242, bulk_buyer 235) but only 22 calls show customers explicitly stated as loyal_to_us, meaning repeat volume isn't yet being converted into recognised loyalty.
satisfaction: Win rate tracks satisfaction almost linearly: satisfied calls convert at 71%, neutral at 15%, dissatisfied at only 5% - with 1,392 calls (51%) still sitting in the neutral bucket, a huge untapped pool.

Price is rarely the real blocker: in 1,916 calls (71%) price was not even discussed to a conclusion, and when it was, 293 accepted and only 84 called it too high - versus 361 calls recording a 'price_high' objection, suggesting slow/unclear quoting is a bigger issue than the price itself.

227 calls (8%) show outright dissatisfaction, and rep execution gaps explain much of it: slow_or_unclear_answer (440 calls), no_follow_up_fixed (421) and no_quote_sent (258) are the top missed actions.

conversion.title: Convert neutral calls into satisfied ones
conversion.evidence: 1,392 calls (51%) end neutral with only 15% win rate vs 71% for satisfied calls; didnt_ask_for_order flagged in 249 calls.
conversion.action: Train reps to end every call with a clear value statement and an explicit ask for the order or next step, not just information.

conversion.title: Send price/quote instantly, don't defer
conversion.evidence: Price not discussed to conclusion in 1,916 calls (71%); no_quote_sent in 258 calls; price_enquiry is the top intent (922 calls, 34%).
conversion.action: Mandate reps quote or WhatsApp a price list/photo during the call itself instead of 'will check and call back'.

conversion.title: Lock in fixed follow-ups
conversion.evidence: no_follow_up_fixed in 421 calls; callback is the top outcome (1,253 calls, 46%).
conversion.action: Require reps to set and log an exact callback date/time in CRM and management to audit same-day adherence.

conversion.title: Fix stock-visibility and alternative offering
conversion.evidence: stock_availability is the 2nd biggest objection (359 calls, win 25%) and top customer need (488); didnt_offer_alternative missed in 152 calls.
conversion.action: Give reps real-time stock access and a standard script to immediately propose an alternative brand/size when the requested item is unavailable.

conversion.title: Speed up technical answers
conversion.evidence: slow_or_unclear_answer flagged in 440 calls; needs_technical_help in 399 calls; technical_advice needed in 447 calls.
conversion.action: Create a quick-reference spec/FAQ sheet for reps to answer sizing, thickness and material queries without 'will check' delays.

conversion.title: Qualify unknown-segment callers early
conversion.evidence: Unknown segment is 1,005 calls (37% of total) but converts at only 25% vs 40% for dealers; didnt_ask_requirement missed in 106 calls.
conversion.action: Add a mandatory 2-question segment/requirement check at call start to route and prioritise correctly.

conversion.title: Counter competitor-cheaper objections with value, not price-matching
conversion.evidence: competitor_cheaper objection in 98 calls with only 21% win rate; didnt_highlight_value missed in 95 calls.
conversion.action: Train reps to lead with stock reliability, delivery speed and authorised-distributor quality assurance rather than matching competitor rates.

offers.title: Promote cut-to-size/processing service
offers.for_whom: Fabricators and site customers needing exact lengths
offers.why: cutting_processing needed in 111 calls; multiple won calls involved urgent cut-to-size delivery before lunch.

offers.title: Express/priority delivery slot for urgent orders
offers.for_whom: High-urgency buyers (357 calls) and urgent_buyer behaviour (290 calls)
offers.why: fast_delivery is the top customer need (492 calls); several won calls hinged on same-day/before-lunch delivery.

offers.title: Sample and test-certificate service
offers.why: samples needed in 71 calls, test_certificate in 22, and quality_doubt is an objection in 100 calls.

offers.title: Consider a structured credit-period option for regular dealers
offers.why: credit_terms objection in 80 calls already converts at 29%, among the higher objection win rates, showing appetite if formalised.

offers.title: Multi-brand/alternative bundle offer
offers.for_whom: Price shoppers and customers facing stockouts
offers.why: stock_availability is both top need (488) and major objection (359); summaries show successful swaps like Radiance to Color On Plus.

offers.title: Proactive WhatsApp price/stock update service
offers.why: regular_updates needed in 215 calls; price_enquiry is the single largest intent (922 calls, 34%).

loyalty.title: Formal repeat-buyer recognition
loyalty.how: Flag repeat_buyer accounts in CRM and give them priority dispatch and a named contact
loyalty.why: repeat_buyer behaviour seen in 242 calls but only 22 calls show customers stating loyalty, indicating untapped goodwill.

loyalty.title: Reliable festival/gift scheme management
loyalty.how: Track and confirm gift dispatch (e.g., Diwali items) against a dealer list, proactively inform recipients
loyalty.why: Multiple calls show dealers unhappy about missing promotional gifts ('Why didn't I receive the usual gifts').

loyalty.title: Dedicated account manager for top dealers
loyalty.how: Assign a single point of contact for billing, invoices and order history
loyalty.why: Dealers are 1,276 of 2,706 calls (47%) with the highest win rate (40%); after_sales_support needed in 48 calls and several billing/invoice queries recur.

loyalty.title: Referral appreciation gesture
loyalty.how: Acknowledge and fast-track orders from referred customers
loyalty.why: referral behaviour appears in 30 calls, a small but valuable, underused channel.

loyalty.title: Consistent-supply assurance programme
loyalty.how: Proactively notify bulk/regular buyers of upcoming stock or price changes before they ask
loyalty.why: consistent_supply needed in 125 calls and bulk_buyer behaviour in 235 calls.

non_price_benefits.title: Fast and site delivery capability
non_price_benefits.why: fast_delivery (492) and site_delivery (112) are top needs; several won calls closed on same-day/before-lunch delivery promises.

non_price_benefits.title: Strong technical/spec guidance
non_price_benefits.why: technical_advice needed in 447 calls and needs_technical_help behaviour in 399 calls; technical guidance directly closed several deals (e.g., PUF vs normal sheet advice).

non_price_benefits.title: Wide brand and alternative stock range
non_price_benefits.why: stock_availability is the top need (488) and 2nd biggest objection (359); summaries show successful substitutions across brands.

non_price_benefits.title: Custom cutting/processing service
non_price_benefits.why: cutting_processing needed in 111 calls, with won-call examples of urgent custom cuts.

non_price_benefits.title: Authorised JSW distributor quality assurance
non_price_benefits.why: quality_doubt objection in 100 calls and quality_assurance needed in 134 calls; official distributor status addresses this directly.

non_price_benefits.title: Flexible advance/balance payment handling
non_price_benefits.why: Multiple won calls closed via 50% advance with balance at delivery; credit_terms need flagged in 93 calls.

top_questions.question: What is the rate/MRP for this product?
top_questions.answer_tip: Quote or send an indicative price/WhatsApp list immediately on the call rather than promising to check back later.

top_questions.question: Do you have stock of this size/brand?
top_questions.answer_tip: Check live stock status on the call and, if unavailable, immediately offer the closest alternative.

top_questions.question: Can you deliver today/before lunch/tomorrow morning?
top_questions.answer_tip: Give a realistic delivery window on the call itself and confirm it, especially for flagged urgent orders.

top_questions.question: Why is your price higher than [competitor]?
top_questions.answer_tip: Redirect to value points - stock reliability, authorised distributor quality, delivery speed - rather than trying to match price.

top_questions.question: Can you cut/customize the sheet to my size?
top_questions.answer_tip: Confirm cutting/processing capability and give a clear turnaround time.

top_questions.question: Can you send the quotation/photos on WhatsApp?
top_questions.answer_tip: Send it during or right after the call instead of deferring, to avoid losing momentum.

top_questions.question: What is the credit period/can I pay balance later?
top_questions.answer_tip: Clearly explain current payment terms and flag any staged advance-balance option available for the order.

top_questions.question: Is this the same quality as JSW/Tata?
top_questions.answer_tip: Reassure using authorised-distributor status and offer to share test certificates where relevant.
